technical-summary: A content-addressed build directory is shared by every checkout with identical sources, but a radiance component's CMake cache pins the source path it was first configured from and CMake refused a build from another checkout. build_runtime and run_component_tests now configure a component whose cache pins a different source path in its own tree (components/<name>@<hash of the path>) beside the existing one, which is never reconfigured or removed because another run may be building in it.
user-summary-candidate: Builds from a different checkout no longer fail on a shared build directory's cached source path.
